title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_left
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_left` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {a₁ a₂ b : ℕ}, a₁ ∣ a₂ → a₂.Coprime b → a₁.Coprime b
formal.kernel_statement: theorem Nat.coprime_of_dvd_left : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.dvd x0 x1) -> ((x4 : Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.gcd x1 x2) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.gcd x0 x2) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))))))

evidence.supports: a1 divides a2, and gcd a2 b = 1, implies gcd a1 b = 1
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- coprime_of_dvd_left 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.coprime_of_dvd_left[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate, which re-checks the constructed proof term against the stated type: `gcd a1 b` divides `a1` (`gcd_dvd_left`), which divides `a2` (`dvd_trans` with the `dvd a1 a2` hypothesis), and it divides `b` (`gcd_dvd_right`); `dvd_gcd` combines those into `gcd a1 b | gcd a2 b`, which is `1` by hypothesis, so `gcd a1 b | 1` and `eq_one_of_dvd_one` closes it. `nat_theorem_inventory` exits non-zero for a name that does not exist, and the `grep -c` requires the admitted declaration to be printed.

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the Nat prelude's trusted surface is empty
evidence.notes: `nat_axiom_inventory --require-axiom-free nat` enumerates the built Nat environment and exits non-zero unless it admits no Axiom, Opaque or Quotient declaration. A theorem cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain, so an empty trusted surface bounds every individual theorem's footprint by [].

provenance.source: statement-only extraction of `Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_left` from Mathlib v4.30.0 (see prior_art), independently proved here as `Nat.coprime_of_dvd_left` and admitted through `Kernel::add_declaration`

notes: `Nat.Coprime` has no separate name in this kernel's Nat prelude (matching `Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime`'s established convention); it is spelled inline as `gcd _ _ = 1`, so `formal.statement` is the pinned Mathlib v4.30 proposition this fact mirrors; `formal.kernel_statement` is the actual kernel-core `render_lean` output for `Nat.coprime_of_dvd_left`, which spells the same proposition in the prelude's own vocabulary. `depends_on` is `theorem_dependency_inventory`'s reported direct theorem dependencies, restricted to the ones that already carry a fact ledger entry (all five do here).
